about: Reference pack for the Hobie 16's rebuild (docs/hobie16-1). Photos of real Hobie 16s for looking and measuring proportions only: nothing is traced into the model and no photo enters the repo. Public domain, CC0 or plain CC BY only (no NC, ND or SA), as for the C22, the J-Class and the frigate. Download with python3 -I Tools/shipkit/fetch_refs.py Tools/shipkit/hobie16/refs.json Data/Reference/raw/boats/Hobie16 (git-ignored; fetch_refs.py reads each file's licence on Commons first and refuses anything else). Bean's own photos of Hobie 16s at Rush Creek, on a beach or on a trailer go in the same folder and are the main reference from slice 1 on. The two pictures in the project folder (hobie-hero.jpg, hobie-deck.jpg) are screenshots of today's game model, not of a real boat: they are 'before' views only.
status: Nov 25 2026: the cloud's own requests to Wikimedia Commons got 'too many requests' (HTTP 429), so the category was read through the desktop app's browser instead: 71 files in Category:Hobie 16, of which these are public domain, CC0 or plain CC BY and show the boat usefully. Licences and authors were read from Commons' own metadata. fetch_refs.py downloads them from any machine Commons answers.

drawings.use: slice 1: the hull's freeboard, deck line and bow profile under sail, nearly square on. Measured on its pixels (1280 px copy, Nov 25 in docs/hobie16-2): hull 888 px long (176 px/m); 0.19 m of hull over the water amidships with one sailor aboard, the deck rising about 0.19 m to the bow and 0.03 m to the stern as she trims by the stern (about 0.11 m to each end once the trim is taken out); a nearly upright stem with about 0.1 m of overhang

slices 1-2: from the stern quarter on a trailer, out of the water: the transoms, the hulls' rocker and the trampoline frame (looked at in slice 1: a heart-shaped transom over a V, nearly upright topsides)

drawings.file: A Hobie Cat rest a day after the passing of its creator Hibart Hobie Alter.jpg
drawings.use: slices 1-2: on a mooring lift, from the quarter (not bow-on, as slice 0 listed it): the hulls' rocker and deck roll, the front beam and its pylons, the mast and bridle Slice 2 (docs/hobie16-3), read by eye: the frame (both crossbars and both sidebars) is a raised rectangle on four corner castings, a tube's underside roughly 0.1 m over the deck; the crossbars run a hand's width outboard of the castings; the dolphin striker's post under the front crossbar's middle.
slices 3-6: rudders, tiller crossbar, the crew on the trampoline, the jib's sheeting and battens
slices 4-5: rig and sail plan, mast rake
slices 4-5: rig and sail plan, mast rotation
slices 1, 3: a hull's profile on the sand (rocker), rudders kicked up, the mast and shrouds

drawings.file: Hobie 16 catamaran on the Dutch coast 3047.jpg
drawings.use: slices 2, 7: several boats on a beach from the side: beams, trampolines, wear Slice 2 (docs/hobie16-3), the nearest boat nearly broadside, read on a 2x crop: broad white pylons moulded in the decks about 5 cm tall under chunky black corner castings; the sidebar's top about 0.14 m over the deck; the mast's foot about 62% of her length from the transom (the game's 0.55 m is 61%); the rear casting about 1.0 m from the transom (rough: the tiller and its crossbar overlap it; the game's rear beam is 0.77 m from it).
